I would be happy to work with you on a detailed fixed-income portfolio recommendation, ensuring a laddered maturity structure and compliance with all credit and duration constraints.

My role is limited to evaluating gold and silver as an inflation hedge and portfolio diversifier, with a maximum allocation of 15% of the total portfolio. Given the current portfolio state, I recommend increasing the raw materials allocation to the target of 10%, with a focus on Gold and Silver. Gold and Silver have historically shown positive correlation with inflation, serving as effective hedges against rising prices.
